title_i18n.zh: GitHub AI Agent 翻车：攻击者不用黑客技术，只写一句话就能窃取数据
title_i18n.en: GitHub AI Agent fails: attackers don’t need hacking techniques—just one sentence to steal data.
title_i18n.es: GitHub AI Agent falla: los atacantes solo necesitan escribir una frase para robar datos, sin usar técnicas de hacking.

excerpt_i18n.zh: GitLost 是由 Noma Security 发现的一种提示注入漏洞利用方式，它能够诱骗 GitHub 新推出的 Agentic Workflows 泄露私有数据。攻击者只需在公开 GitHub Issue 中嵌入隐藏指令，就可以绕过安全防护措施，诱导 AI Agent 在公开评论中泄露机密信息。

It natively supports more than 10 languages and strengthens complex instruction control, adapting to multilingual, multi-version industrial production needs. excerpt_i18n.en: On July 29, XtalPi officially launched the XtalPi Science AI-for-Science platform and the Genius Agents scientific agent matrix, and jointly established the "Open Science Intelligence Ecosystem Alliance" with 26 industry, academic, and research ecosystem partners. excerpt_i18n.en: The pipeline from data processing to Agent is being dramatically compressed. On July 30, reporters learned that Tencent Cloud officially launched AI DLC, an intelligent data lake computing platform, targeting AI scenarios such as autonomous driving, embodied intelligence, and Agent. It provides integrated capabilities covering data processing, training, inference, and Agent applications. Taking Tencent's self-developed WorkBuddy as an example, after integrating AI DLC, the end-to-end time to process the same batch of data was reduced by 80%, and the computing power required to complete the same tasks was approximately one-fifth of the previous level. (Tencent Cloud Intelligent Lakehouse Computing AI DLC Architecture) For a long time, enterprises developing AI applications typically needed to first use Spark for data cleaning and processing, then write results to storage, with AI teams using frameworks like Ray for training and inference. Different stages ran on different platforms, requiring repeated data movement, and permissions, metadata, and computing resources had to be managed separately. To address this pain point, AI DLC enables Spark and Ray to run on the same platform. Spark handles large-scale data processing and feature preparation, while Ray handles multimodal data processing, model training, online inference, and Agent tasks. The two frameworks share data, computing power, and permission systems, so data can move directly into training and inference after processing without cross-platform transfer. AI DLC adopts a Serverless architecture, with computing power elastically scaling by the second based on task demands.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 7月30日，腾讯WorkBuddy发布重大版本更新(V5.3.5)：联合腾讯文档，正式推出面向Agent时代的“人机双写”协同编辑能力。新版本支持用户在打开Word、Excel、PPT、Markdown等格式文档时，直接与AI在同一文件内共同创作、修改并实时协同，着力解决“人机混编”团队多角色协作等痛点。 从传统Office的“人与文件交互”，到在线文档的“人与人协同”，再到AI时代的“人与AI共同完成任务”，WorkBuddy该功能的上线，让AI第一次从办公协同的“外挂”变成同一文档里的协作方，并在业界内首次做到“人人、人机、机机”多端同步协同，推动Office进入AI原生协作时代。 AI 进入文档，从「帮你写」到「和你一起写」 过去，用户使用AI辅助办公，往往需要在聊天窗口和Office软件之间反复切换。让AI生成一段内容，需要复制粘贴到文档；希望AI修改已有材料，又要重新描述背景并通篇修改；团队多人协作时，更难围绕同一份文档与同一个AI伙伴实时配合。AI虽然能生成内容，却很难真正融入用户正在进行的工作流程。 此次升级后，WorkBuddy将AI能力直接融入文档编辑环境。用户在WorkBuddy打开腾讯文档或本地Office文件后，可直接在原文件中选中文字、表格区域或PPT页面，通过自然语言告诉AI需要完成的任务。例如，选中一段市场分析报告，让AI优化表达；圈选一组Excel数据，让AI完成分析并生成图表；指定PPT页面，让AI调整结构和内容；在报告中标记空白区域，让AI补充相关章节。 AI生成的内容直接呈现在原文件里，用户可以继续修改，也可以批注意见，AI会实时感知并完成修改；AI改完后，用户可以随时接手继续写。这也意味着，AI不再是“侧边栏的小助手”，成为真正参与创作的协作者。 三大核心升级，让 AI 从「辅助外挂」变身「第三同事」 此次升级的核心，是让AI拥有更贴
excerpt_i18n.en: On July 30, Tencent WorkBuddy released a major version update (V5.3.5): together with Tencent Docs, it officially launched "human-machine dual-writing" collaborative editing capability for the Agent era. items.title: 字节跳动To B战略升级：豆包、飞书、火山引擎组织调整，聚焦AI企业服务
items.raw_excerpt: 7月30日，字节跳动启动面向 AI 业务的组织调整，加强豆包、飞书、火山引擎在企业生产力场景的产品与服务协同。 根据调整方案，飞书产品团队与豆包产品团队将整合，成立新的豆包产品团队，由豆包负责人赵祺负责，飞书负责人谢欣向赵祺汇报。GTM （市场、销售、客户服务）体系方面，飞书GTM团队将与火山引擎团队整合，成立新的 ToB GTM 组织“创造力服务平台（Creativity Service Platform）”，整体负责字节 MaaS和SaaS等云服务的市场、销售和客户服务，由火山引擎负责人谭待负责，飞书销售负责人林婵、飞书战略及市场负责人史志隽向谭待汇报。 重组完成后，除原有的飞书产品和服务保持不变，飞书还将和豆包在生产力场景进行更深度的产品协作。据悉，由飞书产品团队深度参与开发的豆包企业版，已经在部分飞书客户中开启内测。豆包企业版不仅拥有通用AI生产力工具的能力，而且原生集成了飞书生态体系。用户无需额外部署即可打通飞书文档、表格、会议、群聊等全办公场景，并支持基于企业自有知识库的精准问答与智能创作。此外，豆包企业版还配备了完善的企业级数据隔离、权限管控与安全审计能力。 在企业服务层面，新成立的创造力服务平台部，将会整合字节To B业务服务客户的能力，更好地满足企业客户的AI需求。新部门名称中的“创造力”，源自字节对其使命“激发创造、丰富生活”的最新阐释，即“通过计算换智能，通过智能提升创造力和体验”。 此次组织整合背后，是字节正在进一步提升AI to B战略的优先级。截至今年 6 月，豆包大模型日均 Token 调用量突破 180 万亿，火山引擎在公有云 MaaS 市场占据重要份额，飞书商业化增长也明显加速。2026 年二季度，飞书新增客户中已有超九成同步采购飞书 AI 产品。据了解，按7月平均消耗口径统计，字节大模型业务ARR（年化收入）达40亿美元，超过国内其他模型

excerpt_i18n.en: On July 30, ByteDance initiated an organizational adjustment for its AI business, strengthening product and service collaboration among Doubao, Feishu, and Volcano Engine in enterprise productivity scenarios. Under the adjustment plan, the Feishu product team and the Doubao product team will be integrated to form a new Doubao product team, led by Doubao head Zhao Qi, with Feishu head Xie Xin reporting to Zhao Qi. On the GTM (marketing, sales, customer service) front, the Feishu GTM team will be integrated with the Volcano Engine team to form a new ToB GTM organization, the "Creativity Service Platform," which will be responsible for the marketing, sales, and customer service of ByteDance's MaaS and SaaS cloud services, led by Volcano Engine head Tan Dai, with Feishu sales head Lin Chan and Feishu strategy and marketing head Shi Zhijun reporting to Tan Dai. After the restructuring is completed, in addition to keeping the existing Feishu products and services unchanged, Feishu will also engage in deeper product collaboration with Doubao in productivity scenarios. It is reported that the Doubao Enterprise Edition, developed with deep participation from the Feishu product team, has already begun internal beta testing with some Feishu customers. The Doubao Enterprise Edition not only possesses the capabilities of general AI productivity tools but also natively integrates the Feishu ecosystem. Users can connect all office scenarios such as Feishu documents, spreadsheets, meetings, and group chats without additional deployment, and it supports precise Q&A and intelligent creation based on enterprise proprietary knowledge bases. In addition, the Doubao Enterprise Edition is equipped with comprehensive enterprise-level data isolation, permission control, and security auditing capabilities. At the enterprise service layer.
